Amit Rao: Hey team — quick heads up. Priya on my squad needs Dec 30 off for a religious observance. Dec 30 is inside the year-end PTO blackout window. She has one floating holiday unused and ~3 days PTO (prorated, shes 0.8 FTE UK-based). Can we swap the floating day or otherwise make an exception?
Diego (People Ops): Hi Amit  thanks for flagging. We treat bona fide religious observance requests as eligible for accommodation. Options: 1) swap an unused floating holiday (preferred), 2) mark as "Religious Accommodation" paid day that bypasses the blackout (manager approval required), or 3) advance PTO if the employee prefers to preserve the floating day. For part-time UK folks accruals are prorated — Payroll needs to post the prorated paycode.
Priya: Thanks everyone. Id prefer to use the floating holiday if possible so its not taken from my PTO balance. Happy to upload a short note confirming the date.
Amit Rao: I approve the swap. Confirming here so payroll/people-ops have manager sign-off.
Suki (Payroll): FYI for payroll: floating holiday swap is fine. When People Ops flags an "Accommodation Swap" we will code the day as FloatingHoliday rather than PTO, and prorate by 0.8 FTE for pay. If the floating holiday was already used earlier this year we cant reassign it; please confirm unused status before we post. Processing ETA ~2 business days after People Ops ticket.
Priya: Confirmed the floating holiday is unused. Filed the Floating Holiday Swap form: https://intranet.redwood/hr/forms/floating-swap (internal). I attached a 1-line note with the observance date.
Diego (People Ops): Policy excerpt for thread: ```
Religious Accommodation / Floating Holiday Swap: Managers may approve a one-off floating holiday swap or mark up to 2 days per calendar year as "Religious Accommodation" when requested for bona fide observance. Requests during year-end blackout require manager approval and People Ops marking in the system to bypass blackout rules. Documentation (short employee statement) is recommended but not always required.```
Nadia (Legal): Quick compliance note  be consistent across regions. People Ops, please add an audit note indicating reason and manager approval to avoid ad hoc precedent.
Suki (Payroll): Thanks  once People Ops marks the request well post the FloatingHoliday code, prorate pay, and update the accrual ledger. Priya  youll see the change on your next payslip if processed before cutoff; otherwise it will appear on the following cycle.
HR-Bot: Ticket HR-2026-2250 created for Priya  please attach form or reply here if anything else needed.
Priya: Thanks all. Amit  appreciate the quick approval.
Amit Rao: No problem  happy to help. Please ping if payroll needs anything else. :thumbsup:
Diego (People Ops): Marking this as "Accommodation Swap - Religious" in the system and ccing Payroll. Closing loop when posted.
Suki (Payroll): Will update ticket when posted.
Amit Rao: Thanks team.
